description: Body of `POST /api/v1/gateway/ticket` (an empty body or `{}` as before).

origin.description:
Flag `app_origins`: the web origin the browser reached the App on,
`wss://<host>[:port]`, set by the App's server from the browser's Host. It must be the
session App's `origin` or one of its `origins` (`422 invalid_state` `origin_not_listed`
otherwise), and the ticket's `url` is then `<origin>/api/v1/gateway?v=1&encoding=json`.
Absent: the install's gateway URL (unchanged behaviour).

title: GatewayTicketRequest
